migrationPolicy.dataBackfill: No schema or data migration belongs to this package.
migrationPolicy.rollback: Revert only files in allowedPaths; architecture changes require a new freeze.

compatibilityPolicy.strategy: Consume frozen contracts without changing their semantics.
compatibilityPolicy.supportedVersions: Only versions listed in inputContracts and outputContracts.
compatibilityPolicy.removalGate: Removal requires a superseding decision, migration evidence, and a new freeze.

requiredAcceptanceScenarios.assertion: Replace with one observable happy, failure, replay, race or recovery assertion

stopConditions: A frozen contract is missing or contradictory
A required change falls outside allowedPaths
A destructive or production-impacting action needs new authority
